command: cooperbench run -n solo-msa_v2-gemini-3-8-flash-flash_10-steps250-compact64k-stepcounter -s flash_10 -a mini_swe_agent_v2 -m gemini/gemini-3.8-flash --agent-config configs/variants/steps250_compact64k_stepcounter.yaml --setting solo -c 4 --backend docker
agent_config:
# Variant config: 250 steps, compaction at 64K tokens, and "Step n of N: k left" on every turn.
# Pass via: AGENT_CONFIG=configs/variants/steps250_compact64k_stepcounter.yaml RUN_SUFFIX=steps250-compact64k-stepcounter tools/run.sh solo ...
agent:
  cost_limit: 10.0
  step_limit: 250
  compaction_token_trigger: 64000
  step_counter: true

model:
  model_kwargs:
    drop_params: true
    thinkingConfig:
      thinkingLevel: high
      includeThoughts: true
